Tom (sales): Quick heads-up — Vectra wants a 3-week POC next week. They need hosted API keys for engineers, a small Dedicated pool (burst to 40 rps), VPC peering, and a billing project with spend cap + starter credits. Can we stand this up by Tuesday?
Nina (billing): We can if we have org_id and billing contact. What spend cap/credits are they asking for? Also need allowed models & per-day quotas.
Tom (sales): Asking for $10,000 spend cap and $4,000 credits. Org id is vectra-ORG-99, billing contact is ops@vectra.ai. Allowed models: small-medium open models only (no 70B). Quota ask: 750k tokens/day, 300 rpm. Regions: us-east-1 primary, ap-southeast-1 for tests.
Amir (solutions): For Dedicated sizing, recommend 2x A10G-equivalent nodes to hit 40rps with latency SLOs if they do 4-6 token/kb batching. We'll lock model_family to 13B quantized and disable 70B in policy. Also set routing pref to dedicated then hosted fallback to tiny models.
Luis (infra): For peering we need: customer's VPC CIDR, a CIDR for peer endpoint, and desired ingress ports. Also confirm if they require private DNS or split-horizon. Typical turnaround 1-3 business days.
Nina (billing): To create the billing project I need a single JSON payload or form fields: org_id, billing_email, spend_cap_usd, starter_credits_usd, allowed_models, quota_tokens_per_day, quota_rpm, regions, hard_stop_boolean. Hard stop needs signed addendum. Do they want hard stop?
Tom (sales): Vectra wants a hard stop at cap. They'll sign an addendum.
Legal Bot: Reminder: include the standard POC addendum (AUP + PO clause) and mark logs retention retention=30d if requested. If they ask for CMEK, attach KMS signing sheet.
Amir (solutions): Quick provisioning example (use redwoodctl or Console). Use a short-lived project first for dev access, then convert to official project:
```
redwoodctl project quick-create --org vectra-ORG-99 --name vectra-poc-temp --spend-cap 10000 --credits 4000 --models "v2-13b-q" --quota-tokens 750000 --quota-rpm 300 --regions "us-east-1,ap-southeast-1"
```
This returns temp_project_id + ephemeral keys. Ephemeral keys: `redwoodctl keys issue --project <id> --ttl 14d`. Recommend RBAC: engs get read/write for their project, SRE read-only.
Luis (infra): If they want CMEK: provide KMS key ARN, we need an extra security review (~5 business days) and signed DPA update. HSM requests escalate to compliance.
Nina (billing): I'll provision once I have the JSON payload + signed addendum. I will also enable hard stop enforcement (requires legal sign-off) and set alerting at 60/80/95%.
Tom (sales): I'll gather the CIDR, ingress list, and the signed addendum today and drop it here. Can someone confirm ETA for keys + dedicated pool after we send payload?
Amir (solutions): ETA: project + hosted keys within same day after billing ok. Dedicated pool procurement/config ~48 hours after infra has peering and regions set.
DevEx Bot: Tip: create a sandbox project first and share ephemeral SDK keys. Use scoped API keys for engineers instead of long-lived keys. Also run `redwoodctl quota set --project <id> --tokens-per-day 750000 --rpm 300` after creation.
Nina (billing): Ticket created: #POC-2093. I'll post the project_id and billing link once provisioned.
Tom (sales): Thanks all — will post updates here. :rocket:
